content: The bad news is you’re falling through the air, nothing to hang on to, no parachute. The good news is there’s no ground.

This entity within each of us, not the ego, not experience, not time or circumstance or place or position, but consciousness only, the "I" divested of all accoutrements except pure sense of existence, this is the Self that contains all power, where essence is greater than the individual, greater than 10,000 individuals, for it is the supporting structure upon which all things are built, the evolving self of the universe.
